data.title: 奥萝拉 · 星屑消散前的深情一吻
data.description: 星光弥漫的遗迹虚空中，奥萝拉的身躯泛起晶莹光粒开始缓缓消散。她双手环抱住暗影的脖颈，眼角噙着释怀的浅笑，献上深情而虚幻的告别之吻。
data.location: cosmic void filled with drifting starry motes and ancient glowing glyphs
data.action: 双手环抱住暗影的脖颈，身躯泛起晶莹光粒缓缓消散，噙着释怀浅笑献上告别之吻
data.lighting: soft luminescent stardust glow enveloping the embracing couple
data.promptProse: In the starry ruins, Aurora's long black hair, violet eyes and gauzy violet gown dissolve into bright particles at the edges. Her arms circle Shadow's neck as he leans in to meet her farewell kiss. He has short black hair visible at his brow and a fitted black cloak over broad shoulders; his outline stays solid against the drifting stardust.
data.animaCaption: Aurora's long black hair and violet gown give way to stardust as she kisses Shadow. He has short black hair and a solid black cloak, his profile distinct beneath her arms.
